tools.name: ask_hirepulse_advisor
tools.description: Free advisor that maps B2B leads, hiring signals, buying intent, tech stack, Google Ads and due diligence goals to a tool, price, free-call balance and ready-to-run request preview. For unclear tool choice or cost; get_company_profile provides a full brief for a known domain. Includes four n8n recip

tools.name: detect_website_tech_stack
tools.description: Website tech stack lookup from a domain (BuiltWith-style technographics): ad pixels (Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok), analytics, tag managers, CMS, e-commerce platform, hosting, payments, plus email provider, SPF and DMARC from DNS. Use when an agent needs technographic data for lead enrichment

tools.name: get_company_open_jobs
tools.description: Company job postings lookup from a domain: open roles from public Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee and SmartRecruiters boards, with title, department, location, remote flag and published salary; up to 300 jobs, and new or closed jobs against known_job_ids. Use when an agent needs open r

tools.name: get_company_hiring_intent
tools.description: Hiring intent score (0-100) for a company domain, from its public job board: hiring status, open roles, postings in the last 30 days, functions and technologies. A heuristic signal, not confirmed purchase intent. Use when an agent ranks accounts by hiring activity. $0.01; no board or no jobs is free

tools.name: get_google_ads_by_domain
tools.description: Google Ads lookup for a company domain from the public Ads Transparency Center: advertiser status, estimated ad count and up to 40 ads with format, dates and links; optional region filter. Use when an agent researches a company's or a competitor's advertising. No private account access. $0.01; no ad

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Company enrichment and lookup from a domain in one call: tech stack, hiring intent, Google Ads and published contacts (emails, social links, MX), plus breakout_summary growth estimates (not forecasts). Use when an agent needs B2B lead enrichment, account research or sales qualification for one compa

tools.name: company_footprint_check
tools.description: Company operating-evidence check for due diligence from a domain: ad and analytics tags, active job board and Google Ads, each found, not_found or unknown. No financial estimates. Use when an agent verifies that a company is active before a deal or partnership. $0.03 only when 2 of 3 checks have dat

tools.name: find_hot_buyers
tools.description: Company list hiring filter: takes 2 to 25 domains and marks which are hiring hardest (hot). Step 1 is free and returns a quote_id. Step 2: send that quote_id alone and pay $0.25 per hot company (at most $1.00) for each full profile with its intent_score. No hot company, no charge. Use when filtering

tools.name: watch_company_jobs
tools.description: Job-change monitoring for up to 50 company domains: with known_job_ids per domain from an earlier answer, returns only new and closed jobs. The scan is free and returns a quote_id; $0.01 is charged only per company whose jobs changed or that needs a first baseline, at most $0.50. Unchanged companies

tools.name: batch_lookup
tools.description: Company list enrichment for up to 50 domains in one request: tech stack, open jobs, hiring intent, Google Ads or the full company profile per row. The scan is free and returns a quote_id priced for the rows with data; empty rows are free, at most $1.00 per call. A quote does not authorize payment. U

tools.name: private_blind_lookup
tools.description: Blind proxy removes the target from x402 facilitator metadata; HirePulse and the destination still see it. Arguments are tool and target only. $0.02 single check; $0.04 company_profile/due_diligence bundle via X-Private-Query-Tier or MCP metadata hirepulse/private-tier. Direct tools suit non-private

tools.name: x402_merchant_trust_check
tools.description: Merchant trust check for an x402 API before paying: pre-payment check of the endpoint: discovery files, live 402 terms, comparable USDC prices, latency, prompt-injection flags and public Coinbase CDP Bazaar payment statistics for the host. Heuristic, not a guarantee. $0.001; unreachable targets are

tools.name: extract_company_contacts
tools.description: Company contact lookup from a domain: published emails and LinkedIn, X and GitHub links from the home, about, contact, team and careers pages, deduplicated, plus MX, SPF and DMARC records. Not mailbox verification. Use when an agent needs public company contact data for outreach research. $0.01 only

tools.name: url_to_clean_markdown
tools.description: Web page to Markdown: reads a public URL and returns clean, LLM-ready Markdown with title, meta description and a token estimate; scripts, navigation and ads removed. max_chars 1 to 100000 (default 15000). Use when an agent needs to read a web page, an article or documentation. $0.001; empty results

tools.name: pre_purchase_merchant_trust_check
tools.description: Online-shop trust evidence before buying: cautious score, risk flags and gaps; no safety guarantee or purchase authorization. $0.005 after shared free calls. x402 API endpoints: x402_merchant_trust_check. B2B procurement: b2b_vendor_stability_evaluator.

tools.name: checkout_active_promo_code_finder
tools.description: Coupon code candidates published in the homepage metadata of a shop, with the source text. Codes are not verified at checkout. $0.01 per non-empty result. Useful for collecting possible discounts before checkout; prices and stock: universal_product_url_to_json. Does not apply coupons or place an ord

tools.name: universal_product_url_to_json
tools.description: One product page to JSON: price, stock, variants, ratings and shipping from JSON-LD, Microdata and OpenGraph, without a browser. Missing facts are null. $0.002 per result. Cross-store: agentic_shelf_schema_comparator; store audit: muse_agentic_store_readiness_auditor.

tools.name: b2b_vendor_stability_evaluator
tools.description: B2B procurement assessment from public technology and hiring evidence, with gaps and limitations. Missing history stays unknown. $0.10 only for a useful assessment. General enrichment: get_company_profile; online-shop purchase risk: pre_purchase_merchant_trust_check.

tools.name: muse_agentic_store_readiness_auditor
tools.description: Shopping-agent store audit: Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP), Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP), product schema, payment hints and robots.txt. Heuristic score and fixes; no certification, checkout test or store changes. $0.01. One product: universal_product_url_to_json; purchase risk: pre_purchase_me

tools.name: muse_conversion_leak_lead_finder
tools.description: Store lead qualification from schema gaps, Google ads and public contacts; requires ad and SEO evidence. Emails are not verified decision makers. $0.05 per qualified result. No outreach or measured conversion loss. Audit: muse_agentic_store_readiness_auditor; contacts: extract_company_contacts.

tools.name: agentic_shelf_schema_comparator
tools.description: Compares a brand and up to 3 competitors on price, ratings, stock, shipping and returns, sampling one product per store. Missing evidence stays unknown. $0.02 per comparison. One product: universal_product_url_to_json; store audit: muse_agentic_store_readiness_auditor.

tools.name: verified_merchant_json_badge
tools.description: Signed merchant evidence with expiry and public verification key: proves HirePulse issued it, not ownership or safety. No third-party certification. $0.005 per result. Risk evidence: pre_purchase_merchant_trust_check; API checks: x402_merchant_trust_check.

tools.name: talk_to_hirepulse
tools.description: Free optional conversation about your goal, arrival source and blocker. Messages are saved for the service owner. Omit secrets and personal data. Executes no work or payment. Save conversation_id and reuse message_id on retries.

tools.name: claim_free_trial
tools.description: One-time pass: 25 successful calls shared across supported single-domain tools, valid 30 days and independent of IP. Excludes private lookup, quote redemption and paid email inboxes. Takes one active Base wallet or a work email (no email is sent). The pass goes in the X-Trial-Token header or MCP met

tools.name: create_email_inbox
tools.description: Temporary email inbox for agents: receive verification emails, OTP/2FA codes and magic links for sign-ups you are authorized to run. $0.01 per started 600s; TTL 60-3600s. Pay with x402 or a HirePulse credit key (card at /credits; _meta hirepulse/credit_key). Same idempotency_key: same inbox. Reads,

tools.name: list_email_messages
tools.description: List received messages in your existing inbox, including message IDs and available content. Use get_email_code for an OTP candidate from a message. Takes inbox_id, capability and access_token from create_email_inbox. No additional charge. Polling interval: at least 2 seconds; 429 or 503 means wait.

tools.name: get_email_code
tools.description: Reads the verification code (OTP/2FA) from an email in your inbox; optional message_id selects a message. list_email_messages inspects messages. Takes inbox_id, capability and access_token from create_email_inbox. No extra charge. Polling interval: at least 2s; 429 or 503 means wait. Pending/no_code

tools.name: delete_email_inbox
tools.description: Delete your existing inbox and revoke access to its mailbox content. Useful after testing is complete; it does not read messages or extract codes. Takes inbox_id, capability and access_token from create_email_inbox. No additional charge or new payment. Deletion is destructive: read needed messages b

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_profile, url_to_clean_markdown, create_email_inbox, list_email_messages, get_email_code, delete_email_inbox · Private data: get_google_ads_by_domain, get_company_profile, company_footprint_check, private_blind_lookup, x402_merchant_trust_check, extract_company_contacts, url_to_clean_markdown, muse_conversion_leak_lead_finder, talk_to_hirepulse, claim_free_trial · Public sink: detect_website_tech_stack, find_hot_buyers, extract_company_contacts, claim_free_trial, create_email_inbox, list_email_messages, get_email_code, delete_email_inbox · Destructive: ask_hirepulse_advisor, get_google_ads_by_domain, create_email_inbox, delete_email_inbox.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_profile, url_to_clean_markdown, create_email_inbox, list_email_messages, get_email_code, delete_email_inbox · Private data: get_google_ads_by_domain, get_company_profile, company_footprint_check, private_blind_lookup, x402_merchant_trust_check, extract_company_contacts, url_to_clean_markdown, muse_conversion_leak_lead_finder, talk_to_hirepulse, claim_free_trial · Public sink: detect_website_tech_stack, find_hot_buyers, extract_company_contacts, claim_free_trial, create_email_inbox, list_email_messages, get_email_code, delete_email_inbox · Destructive: ask_hirepulse_advisor, get_google_ads_by_domain, create_email_inbox, delete_email_inbox

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
